This app is a local player: the built-in channel list and stream URLs come from third-party m3u subscriptions published openly on the internet (open-source projects such as iptv-org and Guovin/iptv-api; collected on 2026-11-08).

The app does not distribute, store, or transcode any TV signal — playback goes directly to these public URLs, and copyright belongs to the respective broadcasters and rights holders. For personal learning and research only; not for commercial use.

Free public sources may stop working at any time: when playback fails, the app automatically tries the next source, and you can add your own subscriptions via Import channel sources.

The app uploads no data. It only accesses the stream URLs you play; favorites and watch history stay on this device.
